StartupDescription: a bench-top robot that runs routine blood tests
Problem: routine blood tests are run by hand, which ties up two technologists on every shift
PilotScope: one robot running the top 5 routine panels on the day shift
SuccessCriteria: 95% agreement with manual results and a 30% reduction in technologist hours
ConversionIntent: enter discussions to deploy at 3 further sites at about $40,000 per unit per year
NextStep: a scoping call with the lab and IT teams by 2027-01-15
